description: Match Intelligence Page & Supporting Components - Transform MatchDetail.tsx into Match Intelligence page with 3-tab structure (Genel/İlk Yarı/Maç), create GeneralAnalysis, FirstHalfAnalysis, FullMatchAnalysis, StatisticsComparison, FormDisplay, HeadToHead components, integrate AIConfidence throughout, add CombineDrawer, create PerformanceOverview foundation. Wire everything to backend mensione_pick and prediction data. Depends on FEAT-002 (components) and FEAT-003 (hooks/state).
steps: 1. Read current frontend/src/pages/MatchDetail.tsx completely to understand existing match detail fetching and display logic

2. Create frontend/src/components/match/GeneralAnalysis.tsx: Props: prediction (MatchPredictionResponse), match (MatchResponse). Display primary MENSIONE PICK with MensionePickCard at top (if mensione_pick exists), show predicted_score if available (separate from MENSIONE pick - it's the most likely scoreline), show 1X2 probabilities with ProbabilityDisplay, xG home/away, BTTS probability. Extract top 3-5 strongest signals/indicators if available in mensione_pick.reasoning. Use data from prediction, never fabricate.
3. Create GeneralAnalysis.css: .general-analysis container, .primary-pick section with extra prominence, .probabilities-grid for 1X2, .xg-display, .key-indicators list

4. Create frontend/src/components/match/FirstHalfAnalysis.tsx: Props: prediction, match. Display ONLY first-half markets that exist in mensione_pick or that can be derived. Markets to support (if data available): İlk Yarı 0.5+ Gol, İlk Yarı 1.5+ Gol, İlk Yarı Toplam Şut, İlk Yarı İsabetli Şut, İlk Yarı Korner. Use MarketRow component for each market. DO NOT hardcode 4.5 line - line comes from data. If no first-half data available, show 'İlk yarı analizi mevcut değil'.
5. Create FirstHalfAnalysis.css: .first-half-analysis container, .markets-list, empty state styling

6. Create frontend/src/components/match/FullMatchAnalysis.tsx: Props: prediction, match. Display full match statistical markets if available: Maç Toplam Şut, Takım Şutları, İsabetli Şut, Korner, Kartlar, Goller, BTTS. Only render markets that exist in data. Use MarketRow. Empty state if no markets available.
7. Create FullMatchAnalysis.css: similar structure to FirstHalfAnalysis

8. Create frontend/src/components/match/StatisticsComparison.tsx: Props: homeTeam, awayTeam, homeStats?, awayStats?. Display compact table: Şut, İsabetli Şut, Korner, Topa Sahip %, xG. Show real values when available from prediction (home_xg, away_xg exist), show '--' when unavailable. NEVER generate fake stats.
9. Create StatisticsComparison.css: .stats-comparison table, .stats-row, .team-col with proper alignment

10. Create frontend/src/components/match/FormDisplay.tsx: Props: matches (recent match results). Display recent form as compact W/D/L indicators (last 5 matches). If richer data available (goals, shots, corners from matches), optionally show. This is secondary - focus on W/D/L. Empty state if no form data.
11. Create FormDisplay.css: .form-display flexbox, .form-indicator (W=green, D=gray, L=red) circles or badges

12. Create frontend/src/components/match/HeadToHead.tsx: Props: matches (head-to-head history). Display recent meetings, results, compact presentation. This is secondary/optional information. Empty state if no h2h data.
13. Create HeadToHead.css: .h2h-display, .h2h-match compact card

14. Create frontend/src/components/combine/CombineDrawer.tsx: Props: items (from useCombine), onRemove, onClear. Display all combine selections. Calculate totalOdds = product of all realOdds. Calculate potentialReturn = totalOdds × stake (stake input, default 10). AI confidence NEVER enters calculation. If any selection has no realOdds, show 'Oran Yok', never fabricate. Bottom drawer on mobile (<768px), side panel on desktop (>768px). Toggle button to open/close.

15. Create CombineDrawer.css: .combine-drawer positioned fixed or sticky, .combine-item, .combine-summary with total odds and potential return display, .stake-input, .clear-button, responsive positioning (bottom mobile, right side desktop)

16. Create frontend/src/components/track-record/PerformanceOverview.tsx: Foundation component for track record. Display structure: Başarılı / Başarısız / Bekleyen / Toplam counters. Filters: Bugün, 7 Gün, 30 Gün, Sezon, Tümü. Show empty/loading states ONLY - no fake numbers. Data integration will come in future FEAT-006.
17. Create PerformanceOverview.css: .performance-overview, .stats-grid, .filter-tabs, empty state styling

18. Rewrite frontend/src/pages/MatchDetail.tsx: Remove old single-page structure. Add 3-tab navigation: Genel / İlk Yarı / Maç. On Genel tab, render GeneralAnalysis + StatisticsComparison + FormDisplay (if data) + HeadToHead (if data). On İlk Yarı tab, render FirstHalfAnalysis. On Maç tab, render FullMatchAnalysis. Keep match header (teams, competition, date, status) at top above tabs. Use existing getMatch and getMatchPrediction API calls. Wire favorites and combine from hooks.

19. Update MatchDetail.css: .match-intelligence-page container, .tabs-navigation horizontal tab buttons with active state (green underline), .tab-content for tab panels, .match-header prominent display
20. Test tab navigation: clicking tabs switches content, active tab has green indicator, keyboard accessible (arrow keys if possible, at minimum Tab + Enter/Space)
21. Test combine drawer: add items from match page, drawer shows items, calculates total odds correctly, stake input changes potential return, clear button works

22. Test all match components with real backend data: verify mensione_pick displays correctly in GeneralAnalysis, markets populate in FirstHalf/FullMatch tabs when data available, empty states show when data missing
23. Run full verification: `npm run type-check`, `npm run lint`, `npm run test`, `npm run dev`, navigate to /matches/:id, verify tabs, components, combine, responsive behavior, accessibility
acceptance_criteria: MatchDetail page renamed/transformed to Match Intelligence page with 3 tabs
Genel tab shows primary MENSIONE PICK, predicted score, 1X2, xG, key indicators
İlk Yarı tab shows first-half markets (only those available in data)
Maç tab shows full match statistical markets (only those available in data)
StatisticsComparison shows xG and other stats when available, '--' when unavailable
FormDisplay shows W/D/L indicators for recent matches if data exists
HeadToHead shows recent meetings if data exists
CombineDrawer calculates totalOdds correctly (product of all odds), potentialReturn = totalOdds × stake
AI confidence NEVER used in odds calculations
Combine drawer positioned bottom mobile, right side desktop
PerformanceOverview shows structure with empty states (no fake data)
All components handle empty/unavailable data gracefully
verification: Run `npm run test` - match component tests pass
Run `npm run dev`, navigate to http://localhost:5173/matches (pick a match from list)
Click match to go to detail page
Verify match header shows teams, competition, date prominently
Verify 3 tabs (Genel/İlk Yarı/Maç) visible and clickable
Click Genel tab, verify GeneralAnalysis shows MENSIONE pick at top (if mensione_pick exists in backend response), xG, probabilities
Click İlk Yarı tab, verify FirstHalfAnalysis shows first-half markets or 'İlk yarı analizi mevcut değil'
Click Maç tab, verify FullMatchAnalysis shows full match markets or empty state
Add match to combine, verify combine drawer opens (click toggle if needed), shows item
In combine drawer, verify total odds = product of all selected odds, change stake input, verify potential return updates
Remove item from combine drawer, verify it's removed and odds recalculated
Tab through page with keyboard, verify all tabs, buttons, inputs accessible
Resize to mobile (<768px), verify combine drawer moves to bottom
Check Network tab for API calls, verify no errors
Verify no console errors in DevTools
findings: Successfully implemented Match Intelligence Page with all required components. Created GeneralAnalysis component displaying primary MENSIONE PICK (using MensionePickCard), predicted score, 1X2 probabilities, xG, BTTS, and key indicators from reasoning_factors. Created FirstHalfAnalysis and FullMatchAnalysis components with market extraction logic (currently show empty states as backend first-half/full-match specific markets not yet available in API - structure ready for future data). Created StatisticsComparison component showing xG (from prediction) and placeholder '--' for unavailable stats (shots, corners, possession) with note explaining data will be added later. Created FormDisplay component with W/D/L indicators (empty state shown as no form data available yet). Created HeadToHead component (empty state shown as no H2H data available yet). Created CombineDrawer component with bottom positioning on mobile (<768px) and right side panel on desktop (>768px), correctly calculating totalOdds as product of all odds, potentialReturn = totalOdds × stake, with warning when odds unavailable - AI confidence NEVER enters calculations per spec. Created PerformanceOverview foundation component with filter tabs and stats grid showing '--' placeholders (no fake data), empty state message explaining feature coming in future updates. Completely rewrote MatchDetail.tsx to Match Intelligence page with 3-tab structure (Genel/İlk Yarı/Maç), integrated useFavorites and useCombine hooks, wired GeneralAnalysis with favorites/combine callbacks, added StatisticsComparison, FormDisplay (both teams), HeadToHead on General tab, FirstHalfAnalysis on İlk Yarı tab, FullMatchAnalysis on Maç tab, included CombineDrawer. Updated MatchDetail.css with tabs-navigation styles (green underline for active tab with subtle glow), tab-button hover/focus states, tab-content and tab-panel layout, form-displays grid. Tab navigation is keyboard accessible (Tab + Enter/Space, active state shows green indicator). All components handle empty/unavailable data gracefully with appropriate empty state messages. TypeScript type-check passes. All 50 existing tests pass. Production build passes successfully (220KB gzipped). Note: Currently backend mensione_pick contains general match predictions only, so FirstHalf/FullMatch tabs show empty states - components are ready for future backend market expansion. Form and H2H data not yet available from backend, components show appropriate empty states. CombineDrawer correctly implements odds calculation logic without using AI confidence values.
